evidence: All acceptance criteria met: (1) API/TUI fields now use explicit unit suffixes (tan_mg_n_per_l, nitrite_mg_n_per_l, phosphate_mg_p_per_l, dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_c_per_l, estimated_tds_7_ion_mg_per_l, estimated_conductivity_us_cm) so users can tell whether a value is N-as-element, P-as-element, or a 7-ion estimate.

(2) Conversion logic is centralized in conversions.rs with named constants (NO3_PER_N, NO2_PER_N, NH4_PER_N, NH3_PER_N, PO4_PER_P) documented with molar mass derivations. Round-trip unit tests verify all five conversions within 1e-12 tolerance.

(3) GH/KH coefficients in water.rs are now named constants (CALCIUM_AS_CACO3_FACTOR, MAGNESIUM_AS_CACO3_FACTOR, MG_CACO3_PER_MEQ, MG_CACO3_PER_DEGREE, MOLAR_MASS_CACO3_G_PER_MOL, MOLAR_MASS_CALCIUM_G_PER_MOL, MOLAR_MASS_MAGNESIUM_G_PER_MOL) with doc comments explaining the CaCO3-basis derivation.
(4) The conductivity divisor 0.65 is now ESTIMATED_TDS_TO_CONDUCTIVITY_DIVISOR with doc comment explaining it is an empirical freshwater approximation for display only.

(5) TDS/conductivity labeled as estimates: field names include 'estimated_' prefix, TUI shows 'Est. TDS (7-ion)' and 'Est. conductivity (7-ion)', and OMITTED_TDS_CONTRIBUTORS correctly states tracked species (TAN/NH3, NO2, NO3, PO4) are excluded from the estimate.
(6) TUI scope lines (ESTIMATED_TDS_SCOPE_LINES) now tell user which 7 ions are counted and what is omitted, displayed on both chemistry and overview screens.

(7) Backward compatibility maintained: insert_legacy_chemistry_fields() backfills all old field names including dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_l. legacy_chemistry_aliases metadata maps old->new names. snapshot_response_json() is used consistently in /snapshot, /time/step, /load, and scenario-load endpoints.
(8) BiologySnapshot includes sub_adult_count and total_shrimp_count with test coverage (biology_snapshot_keeps_total_and_stage_breakdown).
(9) chemistry_field_semantics metadata includes do_mg_l and do_sat_mg_l entries clarifying they refer to dissolved oxygen.
(10) cargo test -p tank_api passes all 3 tests. cargo test -p tank_core --test events passes all 7 tests. cargo clippy -p tank_api -p tank_tui -p tank_core -- -D warnings is clean.
findings_or_gaps: The tank_tui test `screens::actions::tests::rejects_invalid_integer_counts` fails, but this is a pre-existing issue unrelated to this bead's changes (confirmed in prior stage output and by inspection: it is in actions.rs, not in any chemistry/snapshot code).

The overview screen's Hardware panel now has 8 content lines (5 original + 3 scope lines) inserted at position 3, pushing hardware status lines further down. This may cause visual overflow in small terminal windows, but is a reasonable tradeoff for the scope transparency requirement.
The chemistry TUI combined DO and temperature onto one line to make room for scope lines — a practical layout decision that preserves all information.
